summary.text: Ray Ward, listed by Ballotpedia as Raymond Ward, is a Republican member of the Utah House of Representatives who has represented District 19 since 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Raymond Ward assumed office in the Utah House on January 1, 2015, and the Republican primary for his seat on June 23, 2026, was canceled.
In a 2018 Ballotpedia survey, he said he works on health care issues drawing on his primary career as a family physician.

In that survey he listed his top priorities as keeping Utah's economy strong and welcoming to business, ensuring the state Medicaid program runs well while keeping health care costs in control, and supporting public schools.
